name: Sailor's Companion
notes: v1.1.10: Fixed a real item-loss bug in Island Hand Pickup - it only ever credited 1 item and destroyed the rest of any larger pile/stack within pickup range (this is what caused 'drop a stack, only get 1 back'); it also now leaves your own just-dropped items alone instead of instantly re-vacuuming them. Fixed Quick Stack silently resetting a moved tool/weapon's durability to full when placed into a new chest slot. Fixed the in-game Mods Manager showing stale version numbers and incorrect hotkeys (F7/F10) for Sailor's Companion's own features.
